visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pill-style tab switcher whose panels hold rich content

contentPattern.structure: One row per tab: cell 1 = tab label, cell 2 = panel content. Because blocks cannot nest, a panel whose only content is a link to a fragment (/fragments/...) is replaced with that fragment (cards, columns, pricing, other blocks)

usage: Switching between product/service groups, feature vs guarantee sets, pricing tiers.
reuseGuidance: Author complex panel content as a fragment and link it in the panel cell. Background colour is set by section metadata Style.
